paragraphs: Bryan Woo was the lone former Mustang to appear in a confirmed professional game on Thursday, for Seattle Mariners against Los Angeles Angels. Seattle Mariners fell to Los Angeles Angels, 4-6.
Bryan Woo started on the mound for Seattle Mariners.
Bryan Woo worked 5 1/3 innings, allowing 7 hits and 4 earned runs, with 3 walks and 8 strikeouts.
One of his strikeouts came in the second on a 2-2 96 mph four-seam fastball, when he put away Moisés Ballesteros.
title: Bryan Woo turns in a strong outing on the mound
